note: A page nobody has seen: the button CREATES the answer, so reading '42' proves the click happened rather than proving the markup contained it. The first selector guess is wrong on purpose, and the check that it stayed wrong lives outside the catch so the catch cannot swallow its own failure. 'aside repl' starts a fresh session every call and cannot carry a tab - the read call asserts the previous click really is gone - so observe-act-read genuinely costs three page loads, while the batch does the same three phases in one session. Every call asserts its own step; a failed assertion prints no answer, and the harness fails the run because a call produced no answer of its own. The programs load the helper with the session-relative path, which resolves only under aside repl - the surface this campaign runs on. Installed documents use the account-absolute path instead; these workloads keep the old form so the recorded runs stay comparable.
